system.description: Expend a Willpower Trait and leave your body in a torpid state, connected only by a silver cord, to move your senses anywhere at the speed of thought, enhanced by other Auspex powers. You may travel to distant sunlit lands but still fall to slumber when the sun rises where your body rests. You may manifest an idealized image of yourself by spending a Willpower Trait, allowing use of Mental or Social Disciplines at an additional Mental Trait cost, and are invulnerable to conventional damage while manifested, though your body is unprotected. You may attack other astral presences in Mental Challenges, severing their silver cord and casting them adrift.
